items.description:
Single image ads design:
• Quote tiles that will feature quotes from current FernMark Licensees that currently export Mānuka honey. Other creative concept is welcome.
• In 1x1 format and 9 x 16 format
• Use the FernMark Logo and an image of honey in the background.
• The quote will be sourced by the FernMark team, with a maximum of 15
words that will come from a lead team member of a honey company.
• Please refer to previous similar examples in the appendix.

Carousel slide:
• To showcase the FernMark programme benefits, with a focus on educational- related content.
• Design: Refer to the carousel example in the appendix as a guide. Replace the background images and refresh the design to suit the purpose of the campaign. However, other creative concept is welcome.
• Copy: We will provide this to you once it is finalised.

items.name: Videos

• 2 x 15 second videos in 1x1 and 9 x 16 format
• Thumbnails for each video
• All videos must have subtitles
• Utilise the assets provided by us, which feature photo and B-Roll footage.
• Gather sound bites from the Flying the Fern podcast with Comvita and
ensure they are playing in the background of the video footage – specifically the sections of the podcast where they speak about
o how New Zealand’s free thinking enabled the company’s growth
o how being from New Zealand automatically captures the attention
of people overseas.
